review:
Smokey goes treasure hunting through layers of ground. When symbols win, every symbol of that type disappears along with one layer behind it, and Smokey's dynamite blasts away more – Wild Dynamite clears a 3×3 area.

Dig down to the third layer and Golden Reveals show coins, green and gold clovers and collectors. Three bonus games build on it, starting with a gamble or 10 free spins with a Dynamite Collector. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game.
